Moving early childhood policy forward in times of crisis: “3 speed up, 3 reduce, 3 increase”
se: Meeting on Wednesday 18 November 2026 at 13.30 hrs, Committee Meeting Room CA 329, floor 3, Parliament House. The agenda is to consider ways to move early childhood policy forward to support young children's development in times of crisis. The working group that publicises the plan for the policy proposal “3 speed up, 3 reduce, 3 increase”, under the Office of the Education Council, is invited to present information, as set out in the meeting notice. A summary will be added after the Senate publishes the meeting summary.
